walkthroughs.title: Design a room and share it as a file
walkthroughs.description: Asha (homeowner) creates a 12 x 10 ft room, adds, moves, rotates and deletes furniture under the clearance rule, checks it in 3D and downloads the JSON. Vikram (interior designer) opens the file, keeps editing and sees it in 3D. REQ-358 to REQ-366.
